verifications.claim: The Texas House of Representatives is the lower chamber of the Texas Legislature.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'The Texas Legislature is a bicameral body composed of a 31-member Senate and a 150-member House of Representatives.' R6: 'The Texas House of Representatives is the lower house of the bicameral Texas Legislature.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources as the lower house.

verifications.claim: The Texas House of Representatives is comprised of 150 members.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'a 31-member Senate and a 150-member House of Representatives.' R6: 'It consists of 150 members'

verifications.claim: Members of the Texas House of Representatives are elected from single-member districts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: '150 members who are elected from single-member districts'

verifications.claim: Members of the Texas House of Representatives are elected for two-year terms.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Representatives are elected for two-year terms.' R6: 'elected from single-member districts for two-year terms.'

verifications.claim: As of 2025, Republicans hold 88 seats in the Texas House of Representatives.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'In the 89th Legislature (2025), Republicans hold 88 of the 150 seats in the House' R6: 'Republican (88)'

verifications.claim: The Texas House of Representatives convenes at the Texas Capitol in Austin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'legislative work conducted in the Texas Capitol.' R3: 'Meeting place Texas State Capitol Austin' R6: 'Meeting place... Texas State Capitol Austin, Texas'

verifications.claim: As of 2026, the Texas House of Representatives is led by Speaker Dustin Burrows.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2 (2026 article): 'Dustin Burrows, who has been the chamber’s speaker since 2025' R3/R6: 'House Speaker Dustin Burrows (R) since January 14, 2025'
verifications.reasoning: R2 from 2026 confirms ongoing role since 2025; no contradiction.

verifications.claim: The Texas House of Representatives has no term limits.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Term limits None'

verifications.claim: Dustin Burrows has been serving as Speaker of the Texas House of Representatives since 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Speaker Dustin Burrows' R2: 'who has been the chamber’s speaker since 2025' R3/R6: 'since January 14, 2025'

verifications.claim: The Texas House of Representatives is located at the Texas State Capitol in Austin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Meeting place Texas State Capitol Austin' R6: 'House of Representatives Chamber Texas State Capitol Austin, Texas'

verifications.claim: As of 2025, the Texas House of Representatives has 88 Republicans and 62 Democrats.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Republicans hold 88 of the 150 seats in the House and ... 20 of the 31 seats in the Senate.' R6: 'Republican (88) Democratic (62) Total 150'

verifications.claim: The Texas House passes legislation.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: Lists bills like 'HB 1' etc. R3: Describes bill passage process. R6: Legislative body function.
verifications.reasoning: Core function of the House as a legislative chamber.

verifications.claim: The Texas House sets the state budget.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'control over state spending', 'HB1 and SB1, which are each chamber’s version of the state budget.'
verifications.reasoning: House involved in budget via legislature, but sets with Senate.

verifications.claim: The Texas House initiates articles of impeachment.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the House impeached Attorney General Ken Paxton on charges of bribery'
verifications.reasoning: House initiates impeachment, as shown in example.

verifications.claim: A member of the Texas House must be a citizen of the United States.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: Qualifications per Texas Constitution: citizen of the United States (implied in 'qualified elector' and standard).

verifications.claim: A member of the Texas House must be a qualified elector of the State of Texas.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'The Texas Constitution sets the qualifications... qualified elector of the State of Texas'

verifications.claim: A member of the Texas House must be at least 21 years old.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: Qualifications: 'at least 21 years old'

verifications.claim: A member of the Texas House must have lived in Texas for at least two years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'have resided in Texas for at least two years'

verifications.claim: A member of the Texas House must have lived in the district they are representing for the last year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'must have lived in the district they are representing for the last year'

verifications.claim: Regular sessions of the Texas House convene on the second Tuesday of January in odd-numbered years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'starting on the second Tuesday in January of odd-numbered years'

verifications.claim: The Governor can call special sessions of the Texas House.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the governor also is the only one who can call the Legislature into special sessions'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated for the Legislature (includes House).
